meta.title: Image Blur
meta.description: Blurs images in the conversation body only, until you click the Show button in the corner; the Blur button covers it again. Side panels, plugin pages and icons are left alone, and the image file is never modified.

chip.showTitle: This image is blurred — click to show it

settings.title: Image blur
settings.desc: Images rendered in DSH are blurred by default; click “Show” in the corner to reveal, “Blur” to cover it again. The file itself is untouched.
settings.offDesc: Off: images render as-is and no Show / Blur button appears.
